meta: Garage services, car rental, and new and used parts in Vilnius. Contact MB Greičio Auto.
talk: The right help starts with a conversation.
hero_text: Expert care. Your next rental. The part you’ve been looking for. All in one place at MB Greičio Auto.
three_text: From everyday maintenance to your next journey, we’re here to help.
services_text: Tell us what your car needs. Call to discuss the work and arrange your garage appointment.
rentals_text: Find a car for your plans. Browse our vehicles and contact us to arrange a visit to the shop.
parts_text: New and used parts for your car. Find the right fit, build your basket, and send one request.
parts_heading: The right part. A fresh start.
inventory_help: Can’t find what you need? Call us with your vehicle details and part number.
request_note: Send a request without paying online. We’ll check availability and contact you to agree on the details.
step1_text: Browse parts or rental cars, or call us about your car.
step2_text: Submit your parts basket or call to arrange a shop visit.
step3_text: Our team confirms availability, delivery, and payment arrangements with you.
delivery_note: Parts delivery within Vilnius only. Delivery is quoted separately after your request.
rental_note: Contact us to arrange an appointment at the shop. Cars are not reserved online.
garage_note: Garage appointments are booked by phone. Call +370 654 98007 to discuss your car.
demo_note: Demonstration listing — not an offer of actual stock or availability.
unavailable: A part is unavailable or the requested quantity exceeds stock. Please update your basket or call us.
remove_hint: Set quantity to 0 and update to remove an item.
confirm_note: This is a request, not a confirmed purchase. We’ll confirm stock, delivery cost, and the final total with you.
name: Full name
consent: I have read how my information is used to handle this request.
thanks_text: Thank you. Our team will contact you to confirm availability and quote delivery.
visit_note: Call before visiting to agree on an appointment and confirm opening hours.
privacy_text: MB Greičio Auto uses the name, phone number, email, address, and notes you submit to review your parts request, contact you, and arrange delivery in Vilnius. No payment card information is collected on this website.
privacy_contact: For questions about your information or a request to access, correct, or delete it, call
cookies_text: This website uses a session cookie to keep your basket, protect forms, and support administrator sign in. Contacting the shop does not require a customer account.
